**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 7.7**

Section 7.7 required us to pay Brightline "as liquidated damages and not as a penalty" 15% of annual Fees for *each week* an invoice remains unpaid beyond a ten-day grace period. That is a Customer-payable liquidated damages provision, contrary to our preferred position, and its weekly compounding could quickly exceed the remaining contract value.

Proposed redline (validated, ok:true): delete paragraph 7.7 in full, with an offer to accept simple interest at a commercially reasonable rate on undisputed overdue amounts if Vendor needs a late-payment remedy.

Other potential triggers checked and found compliant: Section 9.4 (termination without cause — only accrued Fees, prepaid Fees refunded; no early-termination fee), Section 27 (termination "without penalty"), and Section 21 (mutual cap with no penalty/liquidated-damages carve-out). Service credits and Vendor-payable amounts are acceptable under the rule.
